Gather information needed to construct the final table:

Chromosome and position of each CpG

Variance explained by genetics (e.g., %VE) for each CpG

Associated protein(s) (list all for each CpG)

Nearby genes (within certain base pairs or annotated directly)

Clinical outcome associations:

eGFR (effect estimate or p-value or direction)

uACR

ESRD


```{r cars}

KTR_white <- readRDS("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/EWAS_tk_ratio/ratio_kt_W.rds") #chr and pos and gene
ve <- read.table("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/KTR_CpGs_genovar_gcta.txt", header=TRUE, sep = "\t") #VG_VP
pqtm <- read_excel("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/protein_count_per_cpg.xlsx") #associated proteins

View(KTR_white)
View(ve)
View (pqtm)

#Cpg in clustered order
cpg_list <- c(
  "cg01409343", "cg18942579", "cg16936953", "cg12054453", "cg00490406",
  "cg01059398", "cg21979287", "cg08818207", "cg27537252", "cg03425812",
  "cg12828896", "cg03957124", "cg16306654", "cg03753191", "cg07878065",
  "cg04176813", "cg07839457", "cg16411857", "cg23387863", "cg23904266",
  "cg09249800", "cg11699125", "cg14496081", "cg07830828", "cg02068052",
  "cg24741430", "cg10636246", "cg13575798", "cg26140475", "cg09801824"
)

```



```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
# VE-selected
ve_selected <- ve %>%
  filter(CpG %in% cpg_list) %>%
  select(CpG, VG_VP) %>%
  mutate(CpG = factor(CpG, levels = cpg_list)) %>%
  arrange(CpG)

# pQTM-selected
pqtm_selected <- pqtm %>%
  filter(CpG %in% cpg_list) %>%
  select(CpG, proteins) %>%
  mutate(CpG = factor(CpG, levels = cpg_list)) %>%
  arrange(CpG)

# KTR metadata
KTR_white_selected <- KTR_white %>%
  filter(cpg %in% cpg_list) %>%
  select(cpg, chr, pos, gene) %>%
  rename(CpG = cpg) %>%
  mutate(CpG = factor(CpG, levels = cpg_list)) %>%
  arrange(CpG)

merged_df <- list(ve_selected, pqtm_selected, KTR_white_selected) %>%
  reduce(left_join, by = "CpG")
```


```{r}
final_table <- list(
  ve_selected,         # CpG + VG_VP
  pqtm_selected,       # CpG + protein
  KTR_white_selected   # CpG + chr, pos, gene
) %>%
  reduce(left_join, by = "CpG") 

final_table <- final_table %>%
  select(CpG, gene, VG_VP, proteins, everything())

final_table

library(writexl)

write_xlsx(
  final_table,
  path = "R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/final_table.xlsx"
)


```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
